evidence: In all the growth experiments, a single growth cycle began with the exposure of the Si surface to the TEOS flow. The TEOS pulse lengths were kept constant at 0.5 s. After a subsequent 0.5 s purge time the ethoxy-terminated surface was exposed to either hafnium precursor (HfCl4 or HfI4) or water flow. The lengths of the hafnium precursor pulses were also kept at 0.5 s, as well as the following purge. If water was used after the TEOS pulse, the hafnium precursor pulse followed the water pulse again after a 0.5 s purge period.
